summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long UNH Daily ETF (UNHG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in health care equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of UnitedHealth Group, Inc. (NYSE: UNH) stock net fees and expenses. UNHG was launched on Jul 22, 2025 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
